scope: Deploy ComfyUI-Anima-2.9B-loraPatch as a production runtime patch so original 28-block Anima LoRAs target the correct blocks of 40-block Anima 2.9B.

upstream.fetched_via: codeload.github.com tarball (github.com:443 intermittently blocked on this host)

prerequisite_check.conclusion: blocksPatch sibling project is NOT required here; 40-block loading is already native.

deployment.rollback_notes: Restore production_tools/profiles.json from before/, or remove the custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Anima-2.9B-loraPatch directory. Both restore the pre-deployment behaviour; the node is only loaded because it is on the production whitelist.
deployment.activation_log_line: [INFO] [Anima 2.9B LoRA Patch] installed (base block j -> 2.9B block [0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 7]...). Set ANIMA_LORA_REMAP=0 to disable.

acceptance.method: Same prompt, same seed (645613437897959), same sampler (28 steps, cfg 3.5, euler, sgm_uniform, shift 3), 768x1344. Only the patch state and LoRA strengths vary.
acceptance.prompt_positive: 1girl, solo, upper body, outdoors, cherry blossoms, blue sky, detailed background, masterpiece, best quality
acceptance.prompt_negative: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, watermark, signature, blurry
acceptance.remap_log_line_observed: [Anima 2.9B LoRA Patch] 28-block LoRA on 40-block Anima-2.9B: remapped 1040 target keys to the expanded block layout.

AB_Anima29_before_00001_.png.state: pre-deployment server, no patch, both LoRAs @1.0

AB29_remapOff_00001_.png.state: patch installed but ANIMA_LORA_REMAP=0, both LoRAs @1.0 (control)

AB29_ctl_noLora_00001_.png.state: patch active, no LoRA, model baseline

AB29_style07_00001_.png.state: patch active, painterly style LoRA @0.7 only

before_vs_patch_off.reading: visually identical; residual GPU nondeterminism between processes

before_vs_patch_on.reading: decisively different; patch is the cause

noLora_vs_before.reading: unpatched LoRAs were not inert, they were targeting wrong layers

acceptance.verdict: Patch is active and behaves as documented. Base 28-block LoRAs now influence the 2.9B model on the correct layers. Individual LoRAs at 0.7 render coherent results; the baked production strength of 1.0 (stacked) over-applies and washes the image out.

open_items: Git commit of the staged source and profile change is deliberately NOT made; held for the parallel maintenance/packaging thread.
snapshot/manifest.json development_revision.live_deployed still says false and runtime_after is not written; requires the same packaging window.
CHANGELOG.md entry not written (path reserved by the parallel packaging thread).
Workflow strength re-tuning on the Anima 2.9B recommended workflows is proposed but NOT applied - workflow values are user data.
